text: GOOOOOOOOALLLLLLLL! UNITED STRIKE AFTER JUST A MINUTE! The Red Devils roar into an early 1-0 lead as Hojlund finds the net for a sixth straight Premier League game.
GOOOOOOOOOOALLLLLL! LUTON PULL ONE BACK! What a chaotic start! The Hatters are back in this clash as they make it 2-1.
GOOOOOOOOOOOOALLLLLL! 2-0 UNITED! This could almost be game over for Luton, who have struggled to get going at Kenilworth Road.
There is still plenty of time to find an equaliser - and indeed a winner.
WIDE! Luton break with speed as Morris touches over the top for Doughty, who has acres of space before dragging a right-footed half-volley wide.

text: WIDE! United are in red-hot form.
CHANCE! The free-kick is just out of shooting range so Doughty crosses it into the box.
OVER! Doughty swings a left-sided corner towards the far post, where Osho is completely unmarked.
SO CLOSE! Garnacho tries a needless piece of skill and Morris intervenes in midfield.
Garnacho twists and turns but fires a woeful left-footed effort well over from just outside the Luton box.
CHANCE! The ever-reliant Doughty whips in from the left-hand side, though Morris cannot hit the target when rising above Maguire with his header.
GOOD STOP! United break with speed after defending a Luton corner.
